method: repository file and symbol inspection at baseline HEAD; asset counts are distinct pre-sprint files in Shopping scope and route/method counts are symbols

findings.finding: Draft and AI generation were future concepts; no aggregate existed.
Human approval and deny-by-default write governance exist as boundaries, not a ProductDraft lifecycle.
Versioned audit contracts and a read-oriented port establish audit-reference conventions.
Idempotency was documented as a future write prerequisite; no Shopping implementation exists.
Shopping uses JSON Schema Draft 2020-12, semantic schema versions, closed objects and offline resolution.
Canonical product snapshots and immutable envelope metadata provide the source-reference boundary.
Nine Shopping routes exist and all are GET; mutation route count is zero.
Snapshot persistence abstractions are read-only for this scope; no ProductDraft persistence exists.
Deployment contracts demonstrate authorization, audit and deterministic binding patterns; ProductDraft intent remains non-executable.
Closed transition and immutable evidence patterns exist, but no ProductDraft revision state machine is implemented.
WooCommerce adapter methods are read-only; write method count is zero.
